vetSays.line: A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.

★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Mario was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
